caltable.scope: Create a CASA-readable T Jones calibration table and refuse existing destinations.

toffset.scope: Shift radiometer timestamps by this many seconds.

segsource.scope: Fit atmospheric coefficients separately for each contiguous source group.

sourceflag.scope: Exclude these source names from the path solutions.

tie.scope: Comma-separated groups of source names or IDs that share a fit.

nsol.scope: Number of fits for unsegmented data.

disperse.scope: Apply the frequency-dependent wet-path dispersion correction.

wvrflag.scope: Replace radiometer data for the specified antenna names or IDs.

statfield.scope: Limit reported statistics to this field name or ID.

statsource.scope: Limit reported statistics to this source name.

smooth.scope: Mean smoothing interval for the output calibration table, such as 10s.

scale.scope: Multiply the wet path by this factor before converting it to phase.

spw.scope: Write corrections for these spectral-window IDs. An empty list selects all.

wvrspw.scope: Read radiometer data from these four-channel spectral windows.

reversespw.scope: Reverse the phase sign on selected spectral windows.

cont.scope: Fit the atmospheric continuum opacity in one fixed-interval solution.

maxdistm.scope: Maximum distance in meters from an antenna to a replacement radiometer.

minnumants.scope: Minimum number of eligible neighboring radiometers for replacement.

mingoodfrac.scope: Minimum good fraction required to use an antenna’s measured temperatures.

usefieldtab.scope: Use the FIELD direction in place of recorded POINTING elevations.

refant.scope: Preferred reference antenna names or IDs in order.

offsetstable.scope: Subtract temperatures from this matching radiometer offsets table.

rseed.scope: Seed the atmospheric fit. Zero selects CASA’s default seed.

behaviors.title: Radiometer phase correction
behaviors.scope: Native CASA-readable T Jones gains from seeded water-vapour retrievals, atmospheric paths and spectral-window phase conversion. Includes task reports, direct logging, smoothing and antenna replacement.
behaviors.gap: The compact fixtures have been compared with CASA 6.7.6.14. The recorded ALMA case is pending under #1531.

decisions.record: WVR global phase reversal can miss sparse spectral-window selections
decisions.inputs: A direct wvr.gcal invocation with global phase reversal and a sparse spectral-window selection.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6.14 can leave selected windows unchanged when the selected position differs from the actual ID.
decisions.ours: Reverse the phase of every selected spectral-window ID.
decisions.rationale: Match the documented phase operation and the algebraic conjugation of the ordinary gains.
decisions.impact: A sparse output selection produces the same reversed phases as the corresponding subset of an all-window reversal.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

two-seeds-and-application.kind: Seeded WVR phase, CASA applycal and solver preapply
two-seeds-and-application.scope: Compare the nominal T Jones table, continuum table and log, corrected visibilities and recovery of injected gains across both engines.
two-seeds-and-application.result: Two ordinary seeds, four applycal pairings and four preapply pairings passed.

parameter-options.scope: Compare selected products and antenna reports with the installed task or tool on the same input. Exercise offsets, source controls, flags, dispersion, smoothing, references and failure paths.
parameter-options.result: 19 paired cases and the zero-evidence retry passed. Maximum gain normalized RMS 1.92e-09.

recorded-alma.scope: Compare CASA and native WVR on uid___A002_X8ca70c_X5_shortened.ms on the Mac mini. This requires tailnet access.
